title: Skill frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of SKILL.md under .claude/skills/<name>/ and .agents/skills/<name>/. Follows the agentskills.io specification (name, description, license, compatibility, metadata, allowed-tools) plus the Claude Code extensions. name must equal the directory name and be unique across both trees. Human-authored: no schemaVersion, kind or provenance. Also hosts the tool, model, effort, agent-name and path-glob definitions shared with the command and agent frontmatter schemas. Claude Code additionally accepts hooks and shell in skill files; Maxwell refuses them deliberately: hooks are centralised in .claude/settings.json so no skill can bypass the write guard, and the shell is always bash on Maxwell hosts

examples.name: soc-ledger
examples.description: How to read and append to the state-of-controls ledger company-profile/<company_id>/soc/main.jsonl: record kinds, fingerprints, supersession, and the append/version helper scripts. Use whenever a workflow records a control, observation, finding, risk or incident
examples.compatibility: Requires Node 22 and the Maxwell workspace layout; helper scripts live in .claude/scripts/soc
examples.when_to_use: Before writing any line to soc/main.jsonl or producing a versions/commit_<n>.diff

name.description: Skill identifier: lower-case words separated by single hyphens, equal to the containing directory name

description.description: What the skill covers and when to load it; the model reads only this to decide whether to open the skill, so include the trigger conditions

license.description: SPDX identifier or licence name covering the skill content

compatibility.description: Environment requirements: harness versions, required tools, network access, workspace prerequisites

metadata.description: Free-form string key/value metadata per agentskills.io, e.g. author, version, homepage

allowed-tools.description: Tools pre-approved while the skill is active: a space or comma separated string or a YAML list of 'Tool' / 'Tool(specifier)' entries

disallowed-tools.description: Tools removed from the inherited set while the skill is active; same shape as allowed-tools

arguments.description: Named positional arguments substituted as $<name> in the body, e.g. [company_id, app_id]; a space-separated string or a YAML list

when_to_use.description: Extra trigger guidance appended to the description in the skill index

argument-hint.description: Argument placeholder shown when the skill is invoked as a slash command

disable-model-invocation.description: When true only a human can invoke the skill as /<name>; the model will not load it on its own

user-invocable.description: When false the skill is hidden from the / menu and only loaded by the model

model.description: Model used when the skill runs as a command: an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku, fable, inherit) or a full claude-* model id

effort.description: Reasoning effort when the skill runs as a command

context.description: fork runs the skill in a forked subagent context instead of the main conversation; required whenever agent or background is set

agent.description: Subagent (from .claude/agents) that executes the skill when context is fork

background.description: When true the forked skill runs in the background; only meaningful with context fork

paths.description: Workspace path globs; the skill is auto-suggested when files matching them are touched

x-maxwell.description: Maxwell metadata not interpreted by the harness

kind.description: convention documents how Maxwell files are written; capability teaches a technique (e.g. IaC misconfiguration patterns); catalog carries reference data such as regulatory catalogs; runbook is a step-by-step procedure

workflows.description: Workflows that rely on this skill; empty or absent means it is general purpose

description.description: Human-facing one-liner; must contain a non-whitespace character

toolSpec.description: 'Tool' or 'Tool(specifier)', e.g. 'Read', 'Bash(npm run *)', 'Agent(worker, researcher)', or an MCP tool 'mcp__server__tool' / 'mcp__server__*'. The specifier must not be blank and may contain one level of nested parentheses

toolList.description: Tool allow or deny list: a string of toolSpec tokens separated by commas and/or whitespace, or a YAML list of toolSpec entries

argumentNames.description: Positional argument names: lower snake case identifiers as a space-separated string or a YAML list

claudeModel.description: Claude Code model reference for frontmatter: an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku, fable), inherit, or a full claude-* model id

agentName.description: Strict lower-case kebab-case identifier (no leading, trailing or doubled hyphens) used for agents, skills and commands; identical to the OpenCode agent map key rule so a valid Claude name always mirrors

pathGlob.description: Workspace-relative path or glob (POSIX separators, '*', '**' and '{a,b}' allowed, no leading slash). No segment may be '.' or '..', so traversal is impossible anywhere in the path
